parent_objective: run no-training outcome interventions over M1410 matched/bucketed rows while preserving warmup gate collision/source diagnostics
blocked_by: M1411 admits only collision-stratified outcome probing before retune, corpus export, or training

public_gates: M1412 must run no-training outcome probing only
M1412 must preserve and report warmup gate collision/source diagnostics
M1412 must separate warmup-history-positive rows from reset/zero-current rows
M1412 must not train, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, export a training corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim self-identification from source materialization
do not aggregate collision-heavy and collision-free rows without stratified reporting

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether M1410 staged warmup source rows create outcome-relevant history intervention effects while stratifying warmup gate invasiveness
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public no-training outcome probe only; no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if outcome rows are zero or normal viable rows collapse
stop if accepted rows are reset-only or zero-current-only
stop if history-positive rows are seed-singleton
stop if history-positive rows occur only in high-collision source strata
stop if actor input changes are required
fallback_plan: route to mild-gate retune if outcome positives are collision-heavy only
route to result audit if outcome positives are sparse or reset-only
route to stricter repeat if outcome positives are source-diverse and not collision-only

training_stage.stage_objective: collision-stratified staged warmup gate outcome probe
admission_evidence: M1410 produced measurable warmup command-response evidence
M1411 requires collision stratification before interpreting outcome rows
allowed_updates: outcome probe warmup diagnostic propagation and summaries
status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1412 can test history intervention effects but must still distinguish warmup-history variants from reset/current-frame substitution.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1410 staged warmup matched/bucketed source rows with 56-step histories.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If accepted rows are sparse, reset-only, current-only, or collision-only, record that and route to audit or retune instead of weakening the self-ID standard.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The staged warmup gate source rows will reveal whether warmup command-response history interventions cause outcome-relevant margin/success gaps, and collision stratification will show whether any signal is only an invasive-gate artifact.
success_criteria: outcome probe propagates source warmup gate diagnostics into outcome artifacts
summary reports accepted rows by variant and warmup gate collision stratum
summary reports warmup-history-positive rows separately from reset/zero-current controls
result chooses next route without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: warmup gate collision/source diagnostics are missing from outcome reporting
result aggregates collision-heavy and collision-free rows without stratification
result routes directly to training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or claim expansion

commands.name: collision_stratified_outcome_probe
commands.command: extend warmup_latched_outcome_probe diagnostic propagation and run no-training outcome probe over M1410 matched/bucketed rows

decision_rule: M1412 passes structurally if it runs a no-training outcome probe with collision-stratified warmup diagnostics and no forbidden training or claim expansion.
